h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bulandshahr

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bulandshahr

items.pText: Bulandshahr is a district town in western Uttar Pradesh, within easy reach of Delhi NCR, and its new play schools and private schools are adding outdoor play areas. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away. We send it to Bulandshahr by road, and our team or a dealer serving the region installs it on site.

Pre-primary sections have their own needs. Children aged 2 to 5 are still learning to balance and climb, and they need low platforms, short slides, rocking pieces and enclosed seats. Equipment built for older children is too tall and too fast for them. We help play schools pick pieces sized for small children, and plan a compact layout that teachers can watch from one spot.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play equipment for nursery and pre-primary children

c: , a toddler swing and a low crawling tunnel. These cover rocking, sliding, swinging and crawling, which are the main skills at this age.

items.q: What playground equipment suits a play school?
items.a: Spring riders, short 3 ft slides, toddler swings with enclosed seats and crawling tunnels. They are sized for children aged 2 to 5 and keep play close to the ground.

items.q: How much space does a play school playground need?
items.a: Less than most people expect, since small pieces have small safe play areas. Share your space measurements and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Bulandshahr?
items.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory and send it to Bulandshahr by road. Our team or a dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing.
